classification.difficultyReason: Requires a short conceptual rebuttal distinguishing sortable identifier symbols from a meaningful ranking of categories. This links the taught nominal/ordinal distinction with the taught treatment of codes as labels.

content.prompt: Freddy says that number plates represent categorical ordinal data because numbers and letters have a natural order. Explain why he is incorrect.

spec.description: Vehicle number plate 123 EDL; border, mounting dots, triangular centre emblem. The state slogan is intentionally omitted and the identifier enlarged per feedback.

answer.short: Categorical nominal — number plates are identifiers, with no natural ranking.
answer.worked: The letters and numbers identify vehicles. Sorting the codes does not create an inherent ranking, so the data are categorical nominal.
